subject: Science
description: The water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection
alt: The water cycle: sun heating a lake so water rises as vapour, clouds forming, rain falling on a hill and flowing back to the lake
prompt: A landscape diagram: a lake in the lower left, a hill with a river on the right running back to the lake, a sun in the orange accent top right, and a cloud in the upper middle. Plain curved arrows (no text) go: up from the lake to the cloud (evaporation), around the cloud (condensation), rain drops falling from the cloud onto the hill (precipitation), and the river flowing down into the lake (collection).
checklist: lake, hill/river, sun and cloud all present
a clear closed loop: the arrows form a cycle in the right order (up, cloud, rain down, flow back)
rain falls from the cloud downward, vapour arrows go upward
